frontmatter.name: proxy-control-diagnosing-access
frontmatter.description: Use when a Proxy Control client reports that a proxy does not connect, a subscription «is there but nothing works», a protocol is missing in the app, or traffic stopped — and the investigation goes through the panel's MCP server before anyone opens SSH.

frontmatter.name: proxy-control-morning-overview
frontmatter.description: Use when asked how the Proxy Control panel and its nodes are doing — a morning check, a status report, «что было за сутки», before a planned change, or whenever a summary of the fleet's health is wanted through the MCP server.

frontmatter.name: proxy-control-changing-routing
frontmatter.description: Use when asked to change where a node's proxy traffic goes through the Proxy Control MCP server — block torrents or ads, send some sites direct, route through WARP, a custom exit or another node, give one client its own lane, or roll a routing change back.

frontmatter.name: proxy-control-updating-components
frontmatter.description: Use when asked to check for or install updates of Telemt, Mieru (mita), NaiveProxy (Caddy), the Xray-router or the panel itself on a Proxy Control panel or its nodes through the MCP server, or when a version shows as updating, upstream or rollback_failed.

frontmatter.name: proxy-control-granting-access
frontmatter.description: Use when asked to give a person access to the proxies through the Proxy Control MCP server — create a client, put it on nodes and protocols, hand out a subscription link, or re-send or rotate a link someone lost.

nodes.label: 3x-ui research findings (transfer vs do-not-transfer)
nodes.rationale: Transfer: desired/observed fields, generation marker in one transaction, anti-entropy reconcile, non-destructive adoption, delayed orphan deletion, capability-aware mixed versions, write-only credentials, subscription URL from current state, Profile-Update-Interval, first-match rules. Do not transfer: admin API as node protocol, long-lived bearer enrollment, opt-in encryption, CA-wide mTLS without cert binding, bidirectional merge, DB IDs/emails as identity, 404 fallbacks, Xray JSON as domain model, shared Xray template writes, the illusion that a subscription URL notifies clients.

nodes.label: Per-service certificate boundary

nodes.label: TransactionEngine (apply/resume/repair/uninstall)
nodes.rationale: Reuses _atomic_write, _durable_remove, _operation_lock and checkpoint semantics from scripts/proxyctl.py without parallel copies; 0700 dirs/0600 files; injected process death leaves a resumable checkpoint; uninstall refuses when an owned file drifted.

nodes.rationale: The sanitized report and the generated credentials are written as disjoint files so no secret enters diagnostic surfaces.

nodes.label: DNS/AAAA/CAA preflight
nodes.rationale: DNS is never changed; the wizard prints the exact required records and waits for strict validation: A to a local address, AAAA handled or hard stop, CAA compatible with the ACME issuer, direct DNS rather than CDN proxy for raw MTProto.

nodes.label: sudo ./install.sh front door
nodes.rationale: One entry point: a TTY with no lifecycle arguments opens the wizard; plan/install/status/repair/uninstall/upgrade reuse the same engine, so the wizard is not a second installer and never shells out to a legacy installer as a black box.

nodes.label: installer/ Python package
nodes.rationale: A focused package (cli, model, config, wizard, audit, planner, transaction, release, report, adapters) rather than more responsibilities in one large module; scripts/proxyctl.py delegates as functionality migrates; one transaction engine, one plan model, one state schema.

nodes.label: Global operation lock
nodes.rationale: Prevents concurrent install, repair, upgrade and uninstall.

nodes.label: Startup state machine
nodes.rationale: active verifies owned state; installing resumes from last checkpoint; rollback_required continues rollback; uninstalling continues with the original retention policy; plan/config/release mismatch is a hard stop.

nodes.label: 3x-ui bootstrap in temporary network namespace
nodes.rationale: The panel binds loopback; bootstrap runs with no non-loopback interface, replaces first-run credentials through the pinned authenticated API body, verifies defaults no longer work and stops before enabling the unit; secrets never enter argv, env logs or plans; SQLite edits and secret CLI flags are forbidden.

nodes.label: Secret-free non-secret surfaces
nodes.rationale: No secret may appear in plans, logs, reports, argv, process listings, environment dumps, archives or CI artifacts; generated credentials go only to the root-only handoff.

nodes.label: TCP SNI domain collision rule
nodes.rationale: Incompatible services cannot claim the same TCP SNI domain; Hysteria2 on UDP/443 may share a hostname because the transport differs; a Mieru hostname on dedicated ports may reuse a hostname after explicit validation.

nodes.label: tests/fixtures/vnext-capabilities.json (4 protocols x 23 capabilities)
nodes.community_name: vNext v0.2 local control plane implementation plan
nodes.rationale: Every cell has an explicit status supported|unsupported|unproven|out_of_scope and a note sourced from code; referenced by Task 11 (capture vs rotate) and Task 16 (renderers).

nodes.label: Audit finding 2: Panel vhost is rendered in two places
nodes.community_name: vNext v0.2 local control plane implementation plan
nodes.norm_label: audit finding 2: panel vhost is rendered in two places
nodes.rationale: installer/adapters/core.py::_panel_vhost_text and scripts/proxyctl.py::_panel_site_content + scripts/mtproxy-deploy; neither sets access_log, so /s/<token> would land in /var/log/nginx/access.log; Task 17 fixes both templates and both test sets.

nodes.label: Audit finding 3: uvicorn writes an access log to container stdout
nodes.community_name: vNext v0.2 local control plane implementation plan
nodes.norm_label: audit finding 3: uvicorn writes an access log to container stdout
nodes.rationale: panel/entrypoint.sh runs uvicorn without --no-access-log, so a subscription token would reach docker logs; Task 17 disables it and adds a canary.

nodes.label: Audit finding 6: Credential re-reveal differs per protocol
nodes.community_name: vNext v0.2 local control plane implementation plan
nodes.norm_label: audit finding 6: credential re-reveal differs per protocol
nodes.rationale: MTProxy re-reads links.tls from telemt.list_users(); Naive reveal() returns the plaintext password kept in manager state; Mieru has no /access endpoint and stores only hashedPassword, so imported Mieru access can only be captured through rotation.

nodes.label: Audit finding 10: UI is ES modules without a bundler
nodes.community_name: vNext v0.2 local control plane implementation plan
nodes.norm_label: audit finding 10: ui is es modules without a bundler
nodes.rationale: panel/static/app.js -> js/main.js with TITLES/RENDERERS/bindPanel, state in js/state.js, dialogs as <dialog class=sheet>, CSP script-src self; new modules js/nodes.js, js/clients.js, js/subscriptions.js.

nodes.label: Audit finding 11: Fleet tables and the reserved local node
nodes.community_name: vNext v0.2 local control plane implementation plan
nodes.norm_label: audit finding 11: fleet tables and the reserved local node
nodes.rationale: fleet_nodes/fleet_commands/fleet_certificates; NODE_RE allows local; auth_state has no CHECK; migration inserts node local and poll_next/authenticate_certificate/enqueue get guards by kind=local and disabled flag.

nodes.label: Risk 1: Overengineering Fleet
nodes.community_name: vNext v0.2 local control plane implementation plan

nodes.label: Risk 3: Two writers
nodes.community_name: vNext v0.2 local control plane implementation plan
nodes.rationale: Feature-gated compatibility facade and explicit per-node cutover.

nodes.label: Risk 7: False subscription expectations
nodes.community_name: vNext v0.2 local control plane implementation plan
nodes.rationale: Renderer-specific compatibility; distinguish pull refresh, operator events and actual client application.

nodes.label: Risk 8: Username collisions
nodes.community_name: vNext v0.2 local control plane implementation plan
nodes.rationale: UUID identities and explicit import decisions.

nodes.label: Risk 10: Scope inflation
nodes.community_name: vNext v0.2 local control plane implementation plan

nodes.label: Task 10: Client and AccessGrant tables
nodes.community_name: vNext v0.2 local control plane implementation plan
nodes.rationale: UUID identities; one grant per client and node; runtime_username unique per protocol+node+endpoint; no secret values in grants; suspended client compiles every grant as disabled.

nodes.label: Task 11: Read-only import and explicit linking
nodes.community_name: vNext v0.2 local control plane implementation plan
nodes.norm_label: task 11: read-only import and explicit linking
nodes.rationale: inventory -> proposed matches -> conflicts -> operator confirmation; same username is only a suggestion; import makes no manager mutation; credentials without plaintext require rotation before subscription.

nodes.label: Task 14: Route legacy protocol endpoints through the domain service
nodes.community_name: vNext v0.2 local control plane implementation plan
nodes.norm_label: task 14: route legacy protocol endpoints through the domain service
nodes.rationale: Feature flag first; legacy request becomes domain intent; direct manager writes forbidden after cutover.

nodes.label: Task 15: Subscription token lifecycle and generation
nodes.community_name: vNext v0.2 local control plane implementation plan
nodes.norm_label: task 15: subscription token lifecycle and generation
nodes.rationale: Token shown once, DB stores hash; rotate revokes the old URL; generation bumps in the same transaction; ETag from canonical effective output so expiry cannot leave a stale validator.

nodes.label: Task 16: Canonical manifest and protocol renderers
nodes.community_name: vNext v0.2 local control plane implementation plan
nodes.norm_label: task 16: canonical manifest and protocol renderers
nodes.rationale: Media type application/vnd.proxy-control.subscription+json;version=1; tg://proxy, Naive and Mieru native plus verified variants; secrets resolved in memory, no rendered URL persisted.

nodes.label: Task 17: Public subscription endpoint HTTP semantics
nodes.community_name: vNext v0.2 local control plane implementation plan
nodes.norm_label: task 17: public subscription endpoint http semantics
nodes.rationale: GET|HEAD /s/{token}; format=manifest|raw|karing|html; ETag from effective grants/secret versions/options/time bounds/renderer; If-None-Match 304; Cache-Control private,no-cache; Profile-Update-Interval hint; generic 404; redacted/off access logs.

nodes.label: Task 18: One subscription UI and compatibility matrix
nodes.community_name: vNext v0.2 local control plane implementation plan
nodes.norm_label: task 18: one subscription ui and compatibility matrix

nodes.label: Task 19: Subscription change events without claiming client push
nodes.community_name: vNext v0.2 local control plane implementation plan
nodes.norm_label: task 19: subscription change events without claiming client push
nodes.rationale: subscription.generation.changed / fetched / revoked feed audit and UI; no event claims the end-user client applied the change.

nodes.label: Task 19A: v0.2 local control-plane release gate
nodes.community_name: vNext v0.2 local control plane implementation plan
nodes.norm_label: task 19a: v0.2 local control-plane release gate
nodes.rationale: v0.2.0 cannot be tagged until the evidence matrix, independent security review and artifact verification pass.

nodes.label: Task 7: Split Fleet responsibilities behind interfaces
nodes.community_name: vNext v0.2 local control plane implementation plan
nodes.norm_label: task 7: split fleet responsibilities behind interfaces
nodes.rationale: Stop FleetStore being registry, PKI, command queue and projection at once while keeping TypedCommand, sequence, outbox and mTLS byte-compatible.

nodes.label: Task 8: Replace raw Fleet UI with node lifecycle views
nodes.community_name: vNext v0.2 local control plane implementation plan
nodes.norm_label: task 8: replace raw fleet ui with node lifecycle views

nodes.label: Task 9: Reserved local Node identity and basic lifecycle
nodes.community_name: vNext v0.2 local control plane implementation plan
nodes.norm_label: task 9: reserved local node identity and basic lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Migration creates exactly one reserved local Node idempotently; local managers attach to it; physical deletion deferred.

nodes.label: Proxy Control vNext (v0.2-v0.5)
nodes.community_name: vNext v0.2 local control plane implementation plan
nodes.rationale: Turn Proxy Control into one safe control plane: v0.2 local node identity, clients and subscriptions; v0.3 Fleet v2 and remote provisioning; v0.4 neutral routing policy with native/OS enforcement; v0.5 optional dedicated Xray egress-router. Keep Fleet v1 boundaries (outbound-only mTLS, cert-to-node binding, strict types, journal, no secrets) without turning the Telemt queue into generic RPC.

nodes.label: ADR 004: Client / AccessGrant / subscription
nodes.community_name: vNext v0.2 local control plane implementation plan
nodes.rationale: Client is not username; subscription is a pull projection with generation and ETag; auto-refresh depends on the client; accepted.

nodes.label: Capture vs rotate for imported credentials
nodes.community_name: vNext v0.2 local control plane implementation plan
nodes.norm_label: capture vs rotate for imported credentials
nodes.rationale: Imported MTProxy/Naive access can be captured into the secret store without rotation; Mieru only through rotation because mita keeps hashedPassword.

nodes.label: Client compatibility constraint
nodes.community_name: vNext v0.2 local control plane implementation plan
nodes.rationale: Telegram only understands tg://proxy; Naive clients accept naive+https or native config; Mieru needs native JSON or app-specific profiles; Karing/NekoBox/Shadowrocket differ. The v0.2.0 criterion is one subscription management page/URL plus supported auto-refresh renderers, not a universal auto-applied format.

nodes.label: Decision 3: Remove Fleet complexity from UI, not from guarantees
nodes.community_name: vNext v0.2 local control plane implementation plan
nodes.norm_label: decision 3: remove fleet complexity from ui, not from guarantees
nodes.rationale: Operators never type operation, idempotency key or revision; the application service builds them.

nodes.label: Decision 4: One writer per resource
nodes.community_name: vNext v0.2 local control plane implementation plan
nodes.rationale: After adoption only the vNext domain service/agent writes; legacy protocol endpoints become a compatibility facade, then read-only.

nodes.label: Decision 5: Client is not username
nodes.community_name: vNext v0.2 local control plane implementation plan
nodes.rationale: Client is a person/subscriber; AccessGrant is one concrete MTProxy/Naive/Mieru access on one node; equal usernames are never auto-merged.

nodes.label: Decision 6: Subscription is pull, not push
nodes.community_name: vNext v0.2 local control plane implementation plan
nodes.norm_label: decision 6: subscription is pull, not push
nodes.rationale: Like 3x-ui, one stable URL re-read at a recommended interval; Proxy Control adds generation/ETag and optional operator events; never promise auto-apply where a client (e.g. Telegram MTProxy) cannot subscribe.

nodes.label: Decision 10: Central host is a reserved local Node
nodes.community_name: vNext v0.2 local control plane implementation plan
nodes.norm_label: decision 10: central host is a reserved local node
nodes.rationale: Decided before client import so local Telemt/Naive/Mieru resources get a real node_id instead of NULL or a second target type.

nodes.label: Decision 12: MVP without commercial model
nodes.community_name: vNext v0.2 local control plane implementation plan
nodes.rationale: Product, billing and automatic placement deferred; v0.2 needs only Client, AccessGrant, ClientSubscription and local Node.
